title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Whisk eggs with grated Parmesan and black pepper.
Combine pasta, bacon, and egg mixture off the heat.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka masala paste for 1 hour.
Cook onions until soft, then add tomato puree.
Stir in cream and grilled chicken.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
summary: A quick and colorful mix of vegetables stir-fried in a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok.
Add garlic and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour soy sauce over vegetables and stir well.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.
